{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float (though not needed for age)
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Check how many converted customers have missing age (age == -1)
missing_age_in_converted = (converted_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of converted customers with age == -1: {missing_age_in_converted}")

# Compute mean age of converted customers, excluding those with age == -1
mean_age_converted = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding missing age): {mean_age_converted:.2f}")"}
